message: and it is no container ARIA names as a whole
$reason: A focusable wrapper with a role of its own, around the `combobox` trigger. A written role is not what makes a control — a widget's role or one ARIA names as a whole is: a `region` is a landmark, not the control, and the trigger inside names nothing. Reading any written role as one ARIA names as a whole passes this one, while the reference's `pct-toggle` holds, beside a link, two controls with an icon inside: a native `<button>` an expression may make a `switch`, and a `role="button"` written on a stop, the icon's role one an expression decides. Read off the tag's own role alone, the written one loses its presentational children and the reference fails on the icon inside it.
